name: Central Automotive Products Ltd.
summary: Central Automotive Products Ltd. engages in the development, import and export, and sale of automotive parts and related services. The company operates in two segments, Automobile Parts/Supplies Sales Business and Automobile Disposal Business. It offers engine parts, filter, and cooling parts, such as air filter, belt tensioner, chain tensioner, chain guide, cylinder liner, engine gasket, engine metal and bush, engine valve, fan belt, fuel and oil filter and pump, oil seal, piston and piston ring, radiator, thermostat, water pump, and timing belt, chain, and kit; body-armor maxim, coating, glass coating guard cosme, glass coat, MT-10, SKATO 360, antibacterial deodorant titania, seat coating,…
